Container.Name: Newt
Container.Overview:
For new deployments, our official recommendation is to use the Pangolin Site template which utilizes the Pangolin CLI rather than this template. Newt acts as a tunneled gateway for your local network, enabling seamless zero-trust remote access through the Pangolin (https://github.com/fosrl/pangolin) platform. It securely routes traffic to your Unraid services without complex port forwarding or exposure to the public internet.
Chat with us on Discord!
https://pangolin.net/discord
